title: Parchís: Legends of the Board
tagline: Eight legends. One board. Only one makes it home.
description: The classic Parchís board game, retold as an epic clash of legends. Lead a Knight, Wizard, Pirate, Robot, Ninja, Cat, Viking or Chef across a sunset kingdom: roll the dice, capture rivals with cinematic finishing moves, build blockades and race all four of your heroes home first.
features: Classic two-dice Parchís: captures, safe squares, blockades, doubles and bonus moves
8 detailed 3D heroes, each with their own idle, entrance, ride across the board (horse, smoke cloud, jet pack, frying pan...) and sounds
Real 3D dice that tumble onto the board, then zoom in on the numbers
Cinematic 3D finishing moves: frog hexes, cannon volleys, chest lasers, claw flurries, thunder axes
Play online: see who's online, add friends, send invites and start together, or play 2-4 on one PC with optional computer players
Everyone picks their hero at once, with full controller support and an on-screen keyboard
Living home corners: a pirate ship, dojo, castle hall, wizard tower, cat house and more
Champion podium in each hero's own world, with sore losers
